effects: Sets the signer's single governance delegate to _to, replacing any earlier delegate; no tokens move.
Moves the signer's whole governance vote power (WNat balance plus P-chain stake mirror balance) from any earlier delegate to _to.
Later balance changes follow the delegation automatically, so _to keeps all of the signer's governance vote power until the signer changes it.
When _to is the zero address, the call works like undelegate: the earlier delegate loses the vote power and the signer gets it back.
Delegating to yourself reverts. No native value is taken (not payable).
formats.shown: "Delegate all vote power to {_to}", with the delegate address shown as a named address.

findings.title: delegate: zero _to means revoke, but the screen says 'Delegate all vote power to 0x000…'.
findings.evidence: GovernanceVotePower.sol delegate(): `if (_to != address(0)) { _addVP(...) }`, and undelegate() calls delegate(address(0)). Case 2 screen: interpolatedIntent "Delegate all vote power to 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000". A reader could think the vote power is burned, not given back to them.
findings.fix: Show the zero address as 'None (undelegate)', or explain in the field or intent that 0x0 removes the delegation and returns the vote power to the signer.

findings.title: delegate: intent says 'vote power' without 'governance'. Flare also has separate FTSO delegation on WNat.
findings.evidence: Contract is GovernanceVotePower; userdoc: "Delegates all governance vote power of `msg.sender` to address `_to`." Descriptor intent: "delegate all vote power" / "Delegate all vote power to {_to}". FTSO reward delegation is a separate system that this call does not touch.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Delegate governance votes' and interpolatedIntent 'Delegate all governance vote power to {_to}'.

findings.title: delegate: the earlier delegate that loses the vote power is read from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: delegate(): `address currentTo = getDelegateOfAtNow(msg.sender); if (currentTo != address(0)) { _subVP(msg.sender, currentTo, senderBalance); }`. 'All vote power' suggests a replacement, but calldata cannot name the earlier delegate.
findings.fix: Optionally add 'replaces your current delegate' to the intent.

effects: Removes the signer's governance delegate and takes their whole governance vote power (WNat plus P-chain stake mirror balance) back from that delegate.
No tokens move and no native value is taken.

findings.title: undelegate: the delegate that loses the vote power comes from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: undelegate() → delegate(address(0)) → `_subVP(msg.sender, currentTo, senderBalance)` with currentTo = getDelegateOfAtNow(msg.sender). Descriptor has no fields.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. Optionally say 'governance' in the intent: 'Remove governance vote delegation'.
